name: Sorry Jaan Pehchan Ke Liye Humare Paas Waqt Nahi Hai (Nayak)
visual_description: Anil Kapoor as Shivaji Rao in Nayak standing firmly in a government office meeting room while dismissing small talk from officials.
usage_context: Used to express that someone has no time for formalities, introductions, or excuses and wants to get straight to work or point.
